description: PostToolUse content extraction (v2 contract) plus the tool skip rules. Test data only. `expect` holds what the tests assert; `computed_result` is the full Python output. String values anywhere (args, expect, computed) may be a generator spec: {"$concat": [parts]} where a part is a string or {"$repeat": s, "count": n}; expand by concatenation.

contract_v2.truncate_rule: If len(text) <= cap return text; else text[:cap] + "..." (tail-drop; result length cap+3). Lengths are Unicode code points.
contract_v2.cap_applied_to: The final joined text of the per-tool extractor (prefix lines included), once, in extract_content. Per-tool extractors apply no cap in v2.

dispatch.format: if new_string empty -> ""; else ("File: {file_path}\n" if file_path) + new_string
if content empty -> ""; else ("File: {file_path}\n" if file_path) + content
if command empty -> ""; else "Command: {command}" + ("\nOutput: {tool_response}" if tool_response)
if new_source empty -> ""; else ("Notebook: {notebook_path}\n" if notebook_path) + new_source

dispatch.match: tool_name starts with "mcp__" and is not one of the four above
dispatch.format: lines joined by \n: "Tool: {tool_name}" (if tool_name), "Response: {tool_response}" (if tool_response); tool_input is ignored
"" (no extraction; the cap is not applied)

invariant_assertions.assert: no other caps exist: MAX_EXTRACT_LENGTH, _FIELD_SOFT_CAP and _BASH_OUTPUT_CAP are gone (no per-field truncation anywhere)
invariant_assertions.ported_as: contract statement; attribute-absence check itself is Python-specific

contract_v2.field_coercion: _safe_get(d, key, default=""): missing -> default; str -> as is; None -> default; other -> Python str(value) (True -> 'True', 42 -> '42', [1, 2] -> '[1, 2]').
contract_v2.tool_response_note: extract_content expects a string. The dispatcher JSON-encodes non-string tool_response first (json.dumps, ensure_ascii=False); an absent tool_response becomes "".
contract_v2.cursor_note: Cursor MCP tool names use the form "MCP:<name>", which does not start with "mcp__", so extract_content returns "" for them (unknown tool). Cursor afterMCPExecution payloads are normalised by the dispatcher first; see hook_payloads.

master_contract.difference: Master truncated Edit new_string, Write content, NotebookEdit new_source and MCP response to 5000 (+"..."), Bash output to 3000 (+"..."), and the joined result to 10000 (+"..."). v2 removes the per-field caps and uses one 200000 cap. v2 wins.

cases.name: safe_get_bool_coercion
cases.notes: Python str(True) is 'True' (capitalised). Rust must reproduce this, not 'true'.

cases.name: safe_get_list_coercion
cases.notes: Python str([1, 2]) is '[1, 2]' (comma + space). Non-string values are rendered with Python str(); for nested strings that is Python repr with single quotes, which JSON cannot express generally.

cases.name: mcp_no_tool_name
cases.notes: Direct call without tool_name (keyword argument defaults to ""). Not reachable through extract_content, which always passes the mcp__ tool name.

cases.name: safety_cap_250k_truncated
cases.notes: Assertion is len <= _SAFETY_CAP + 10 (200010). Computed: exactly 200000 'a' + '...' (200003 chars). The cap applies to the whole joined text (prefix included), tail-drop, then '...' appended.

cases.name: non_string_tool_response_coerced
cases.notes: tool_response is a dict here (not a string). Python formats it with str() inside the f-string, so computed_result contains Python repr text "{'success': True}". In the real hook path the dispatcher converts non-string tool_response with json.dumps(ensure_ascii=False) BEFORE extraction (see hook_payloads), so v3 only needs the asserted part.

cases.name: none_tool_response
cases.notes: tool_response null is falsy, so no Output line.

boundary_probes.name: prefix_counts_toward_cap
boundary_probes.notes: 'File: /p\n' is 9 chars; 9 + 199995 = 200004 > 200000, so the tail is dropped to 200000 chars and '...' is appended.

superseded_by_v2.name: master_edit_truncation
superseded_by_v2.notes: Master _FIELD_SOFT_CAP=5000 per field. v2 removes the field cap.

superseded_by_v2.name: master_total_cap_enforced
superseded_by_v2.notes: Master MAX_EXTRACT_LENGTH=10000 on the joined text.

algorithm: tool_name starts with "MCP:" and tool_name[4:] in spatial_memory_tool_names (exact) -> (true, "spatial_memory_tool")

constant_assertions.assert: spatial_memory_tool_names contains recall, remember, forget, hybrid_recall, nearby
